aiOverview.content: Adva Lavie, also known as Mia Ventura, is a 28-year-old Los Angeles-based model and social media influencer accused of using dating apps to target, charm, and burglarize wealthy older men and some younger women between 2023 and 2025. As of March 2026, she is facing six felony charges and has been ordered to stand trial. Criminal Charges and Allegations Charges: Lavie is charged with two counts of first-degree residential burglary, two counts of grand theft, and two counts of unauthorized use of personal identifying information. Modus Operandi: Prosecutors allege that Lavie, who has identified herself as an OnlyFans model, would meet victims on dating apps, build a rapport, and then steal items such as cash, gold, and high-end designer goods from their homes. Potential Sentence: If convicted on all charges, she faces up to 11 years and 8 months in state prison. Status: She has pleaded not guilty to all charges. As of late March 2026, she is out of custody but is under surveillance with an ankle monitor, with an arraignment date set for April 6, 2026. Background and Case Details Aliases: Authorities say she has used the names Mia Ventura, Shoshana, and Shana. Victims: Reports suggest she often targeted affluent, older men, with officials noting there may be more than 10 potential victims. Investigation: The case is being handled by the Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department, which issued a bulletin seeking more victims. Note: The information provided is based on developments as of early April 2026, when she was held to answer to the charges.
